Prototype 7 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EOG (62%), with EEG (30%) and EMG (7%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows suppressed δ (-0.3 dB, sensitivity=7.7) and suppressed γ (-0.1 dB, sensitivity=4.2).
The δ activity is present in 14% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (REM 31% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with REM physiology: EOG dominant, EMG atonic, θ elevated — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for REM.
